title: A Machine for the Signal
author: Kestrel Ravensworth
blurb: Noor Kavanagh, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
